description: tools/test-projects/web-pointer (WEB_PROJECT=web-pointer tools/build.sh web): S93 R2 on the web. Three drags pressed on the 640x360 canvas, which is smaller than the window: released off its left edge, released on the canvas, released past its bottom-right corner. Each release reaches the game once (the counter), the off-canvas ones clamped to the canvas. No pixel check: the scene is empty.
